passages.english: A few days later Jesus went back to Capernaum. And when the people heard that He was home, they gathered in such large numbers that there was no more room, not even outside the door, as Jesus spoke the word to them.

lines.text: A few days later Jesus went back to Capernaum — Capernaum was a town by the Sea of Galilee where Jesus had taught before.
And the people heard that Jesus was home.
So the people gathered in such large numbers that there was no more room.
There was no more room, not even outside the door — the crowd filled the house and spilled out into the street.
Jesus spoke the word to them — the word is God's message, the good news that His kingdom has come near.
Jesus spoke the word to them — He kept on teaching them, not just for a moment.
